Helena Crevar Leg Locks - Finishes.overview: Helena Crevar's companion course on finishing leg locks, four parts. Part 1 covers the types of leg lock, starting with ankle locks. Part 2 covers outside heel hooks (from irimi ashi, and irimi ashi to outside heel hook). Part 3 covers inside heel hooks (from cross ashi, criss-cross ashi heel hook). Part 4 covers toe holds with different grips, kneebars and more.
Helena Crevar Leg Locks - Finishes.for: No-gi grapplers who get to the legs but don't finish.
key: Inside heel hooks from cross ashi

Henry Cejudo - Triple C Mindset [4] (108.overview: Olympic wrestling champion and two-division UFC champion Henry Cejudo on a combat sports mindset, four parts. Part 1 covers being a fighter and competitor. Part 2 covers facing problems and how to approach training. Part 3 covers dealing with critics and understanding your threshold. Part 4 covers studying film and believing in your comeback.

Interplay.Between.High.Step.&.Body.Lock..overview: Nicky Ryan (ADCC silver medallist and Gordon Ryan's brother) on combining the high step and body lock passes, five parts. The high step pass (stepping a leg over the opponent's legs to pass) and the body lock pass create a dilemma: defending one exposes you to the other. The course covers setting up each pass, when to switch between them and how to finish to side control or mount. The publisher listing has no per-volume breakdown.
Interplay.Between.High.Step.&.Body.Lock..for: No-gi passers who already body lock and want a second option.
